experiment_design.construction: For each checkpoint, subtract the mean of four separately L1-normalized control maps from the separately normalized target map, then subtract the Qwen prompt difference from the Holo prompt difference.
experiment_design.teacher_forcing: Every instruction uses an independently image-derived oracle coordinate; no model rollout selects a target or control coordinate.
experiment_design.control_policy: Same screenshot, visible alternate click instructions, one control per distinct GUI region.
experiment_design.stability: Cosine similarity between the four-control prompt difference and each leave-one-control-out prompt difference.
